C1640.title: Research on Immersive Hijacking Attacks in VR Systems
C1640.summary: This study introduces an immersive hijacking method called the 'Inception Attack,' which exploits vulnerabilities in VR headsets to hijack and manipulate the user's immersive virtual environment without their awareness, enabling data theft or malicious code injection.

references.title: Inception Attacks: Immersive Hijacking in Virtual Reality Systems
